subject.title: Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 5

text: Governing Board Member, Placentia-Yorba Linda Unified School District

Public education is about more than reading, writing, and arithmetic. It’s about preparing students to think critically, adapt confidently, and thrive in a rapidly changing world. I will continue to build on PYLUSD’s tradition of excellence while preparing students for tomorrow.

Under my leadership the district has pivoted from wasteful spending to responsible budgeting benefiting all students. I am proud of the progress we are achieving; strengthening our district’s financial future, building trust through integrity and transparency, advancing academic excellence, strengthening special education, expanding career technical education, athletics, & arts opportunities, and supporting every student.
Our community deserves transparent, accountable governance where every decision is guided by what is best for students.

As the daughter of two special educators, a mother of three PYLUSD graduates, and a nonprofit leader dedicated to ending youth and family homelessness, I understand students’ strengths and challenges. My record reflects a commitment to students, families, community partnerships, fiscal responsibility, and transparent, accountable governance that puts students first.
The choices we make today will shape our students’ futures for years to come. Experience matters, so does a clear vision for the future.
I’m asking for your vote for re-election to the PYLUSD School Board. www.carriebuck4pylusd.com

text: It’s time to bring common-sense leadership back!
I’m Justin Aguirre, a lifelong Placentia resident, PYLUSD graduate, and father of three children currently attending our district schools.

For years, I have been actively involved in PYLUSD, advocating for students, parents, and our community. I’m running because I believe our schools must return their focus to what matters most: academic excellence, parental involvement, school safety, and preparing every student for future success.

I will fight to protect parental rights, protect girls’ sports and spaces, keep inappropriate political ideology out of our classrooms, and ensure parents remain the primary decision-makers in their children’s education. I will demand transparency and fiscal responsibility, prioritize classroom spending, and oppose unnecessary debt and bonds that place additional burdens on taxpayers.

I will work to expand partnerships with our local colleges. However, college is not the only path to success. We must also expand career technical education programs, including skilled trades, apprenticeships, and other pathways that prepare students to meet workforce demands.
When elected, I’ll be the trustee with children currently attending PYLUSD schools. I’m personally invested in the future of our district and respectfully ask for your vote.
